name: GPU Backprojection using Local-Memory Tiling
aliases: GPU Backprojection with Local Memory Tiling
definition: GPU-based backprojection optimizing memory access patterns using local memory tiling.
summary: GPU Backprojection using Local-Memory Tiling optimizes tomographic reconstruction by tiling the Z-axis loop to reuse projection data in local memory, reducing global memory bandwidth pressure compared to methods relying solely on global buffers.
